question: Should tours this long happen again, yes or no?

lines.text: The carrier USS Abraham Lincoln is home in San Diego after 321 days away.
lines.note: USNI News: returned after 321 days; berthed at NAS North Island 8 Oct

lines.text: It spent a record 265 days in a row at sea, beating 206 in 2020.
lines.note: USNI News: days in a row at sea

lines.text: It left last November and was sent to the Middle East in January.
lines.note: USNI: departed 21 Nov 2025; redirected to the Middle East mid-January 2026, 5th Fleet around 26 Jan

lines.text: It then took part in Operation Epic Fury, the US campaign against Iran.
lines.note: USNI: role in Operation Epic Fury, the US campaign against Iran that began 28 Feb 2026

lines.text: The Pentagon says the strike group flew 3,693 sorties.
lines.note: USNI per Pentagon release: 3,693 sorties launched; The Week: nearly 3,700 direct combat sorties

lines.text: It says it shot down 77 drones and destroyed 21 anti-ship missiles.
lines.note: USNI per Pentagon: 77 one-way drones shot down, 21 anti-ship cruise missiles destroyed; The Week same

lines.text: It also helped enforce the US blockade of Iran's ports, the Pentagon says.
lines.note: USNI: took part in the US blockade of Iranian ports and coastline

lines.text: It was first due home in May, but the tour was extended twice.
lines.note: USNI: initially set to return in May; Hegseth signed two extensions

lines.text: It left the Middle East in August, stopping in Thailand and Guam.
lines.note: USNI: left the Middle East 22 Aug; Thailand 2 to 6 Sep; Guam 19 Sep

lines.text: Sailors reported rationed food and mail delays, The Week reports.
lines.note: The Week: rationed food, fewer meal choices, intermittent water shortages, severe mail delays; congressional leaders called for IG investigations

lines.text: On Wednesday, Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth gave the crew the Presidential Unit Citation.
lines.note: USNI: Hegseth announced the award on Wednesday 7 Oct while visiting the ship; Euronews: presented it Wednesday

lines.text: The Week says 122 new fathers went ashore first to meet their babies.
lines.note: The Week: 122 new fathers were given priority to disembark to meet infants born during the deployment

lines.text: Should tours this long happen again, yes or no?

caption: USS Abraham Lincoln, San Diego: the US aircraft carrier is home after 321 days away, including a record 265 days in a row at sea. The Pentagon says its strike group flew 3,693 sorties in the campaign against Iran. Should tours this long happen again, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 8 Oct 2026: carrier berthed at NAS North Island on the afternoon of 8 Oct (US time); USNI News 19:21 UTC, Euronews 20:32 UTC, NPR, Sky News, Al Jazeera, PACOM; about 13h old at the 09:00 UK slot

Removal-risk: a homecoming that happened, combat figures attributed to the Pentagon, crew conditions attributed to The Week; no casualties or tolls, suicide reports deliberately left out; no future-attack framing (Trump's strike pause left out); neutral yes/no
